name: Equity sell-off with a gold rally
description: Market down 15% through factor betas, gold funds up 10% as a direct shock.
rationale: Illustrative, not a forecast. In two of the six replay windows the gold fund rose while Nifty 50 fell (Sep 2024 - Mar 2025: gold fund +13.5%, Nifty -15.8%; Jan - Mar 2026: +8.3% vs -15.2%, from our cache); in the demonetisation window it fell 9.8%, so a gold rally is a scenario choice, not a rule. The gold shock is direct because the gold fund's equity-factor betas are near 0.
